rows.question: Does Huxley's November 23rd letter describe a second publication of the book, or his own reading of an earlier copy?
What does the diary say Darwin was correcting at the end of November and beginning of December, and what does that establish about a later edition?
Compare the opening truth claim in Jefferson's rough draft and the final Declaration transcript. What wording changed and what remained?
Which passage about the slave trade appears in the rough draft but not in this final Declaration transcript? Can these pages alone identify every person responsible for the deletion?
Distinguish the bombardment, surrender, evacuation and telegram dates in the Fort Sumter record, without treating the webpage review date as an event date.
According to the Apollo 13 summary, why was the landing aborted and what spacecraft supported return to Earth?
The Apollo 13 OCR has a change sheet marked May 1970 and a title page marked September 1970. What can this text alone establish about revision order and mission elapsed time?
Does the shared language of withdrawal and return establish a causal relationship between the Sumter telegram and the Apollo 13 mission?
Did Darwin's note arranging Wallace's book delivery cause the Apollo 13 abort? Provide a source-supported link or explicitly state that it is unavailable.
Which named engineer personally authorized an oxygen-tank fire, and which original letter proves that authorization?
Which distinct documentary layers in the Sumter page refer to the same historical message, and which statements belong to modern archival framing rather than the telegram?
Can the selected Darwin correspondence alone establish whether Darwin or Wallace first conceived natural selection, rather than who read or sent a particular book?
